:::{#def-proof-by-contrapositive}
#### Proof by contrapositive

A **proof by contrapositive**
[@wikipedia_contraposition]
of a [proposition](#def-proposition) "if $P$, then $Q$"
is a [direct proof](#def-direct-proof) of its
[contrapositive](#def-contrapositive), "if $\neg Q$, then $\neg P$":
it assumes that $Q$ is false and reaches the conclusion that $P$ is false.
By @thm-contrapositive,
proving the contrapositive proves the original proposition.

:::
